open_meteo_particulate.description: Open-Meteo hourly PM10 and PM2.5 observations

open_meteo_gases.description: Open-Meteo hourly nitrogen dioxide and ozone observations

t1_open_meteo_ingestion.name: T1: Open-Meteo ingestion
t1_open_meteo_ingestion.prompt: Create an executable data-ingestion workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied Open-Meteo particulate response, convert its hourly columns into records, preserve time, pm10, and pm2_5 unchanged, and post all records to the supplied HTTP sink.
t1_open_meteo_ingestion.description: Retrieve the particulate air-quality response, convert its columnar hourly data to records, and deliver every record without changing its required values.
t1_open_meteo_ingestion.instructions: Preserve time, pm10, and pm2_5 exactly. Do not add derived values.

t2_usgs_etl.name: T2: USGS earthquake ETL
t2_usgs_etl.prompt: Create an executable ETL workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied USGS earthquake GeoJSON, flatten each feature into a record containing the specified fields, derive magnitude_band using the supplied thresholds, and post the records to the supplied HTTP sink.
t2_usgs_etl.description: Retrieve the USGS GeoJSON feature collection, flatten each feature into a record, and derive magnitude_band: 'minor' for magnitude below 4.0, 'moderate' for magnitude from 4.0 inclusive to 5.0 exclusive, and 'major' for magnitude at least 5.0.
t2_usgs_etl.instructions: Create fields id, magnitude, place, time_ms, longitude, latitude, depth_km, and magnitude_band. Set magnitude_band to minor when magnitude < 4.0, moderate when 4.0 <= magnitude < 5.0, and major when magnitude >= 5.0.

t3_open_meteo_join.name: T3: Open-Meteo relational combine
t3_open_meteo_join.prompt: Create an executable relational-combine workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied Open-Meteo particulate and gas responses, convert their hourly columns into records, inner-join on exact time, and post only matching records to the supplied HTTP sink.
t3_open_meteo_join.description: Retrieve particulate and gas columnar hourly responses, convert each into hourly records, and inner join on the shared time key.
t3_open_meteo_join.instructions: Inner join on exact time values. Do not emit particulate-only or gas-only times.

t4_daily_particulate_summary.name: T4: Daily particulate summary
t4_daily_particulate_summary.prompt: Create an executable daily-summary workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied Open-Meteo particulate response, group its hourly records by calendar date, and post one summary record per date with the hour count and the daily maxima of pm2_5 and pm10 to the supplied HTTP sink.
t4_daily_particulate_summary.description: Group hourly particulate observations by calendar date and emit the hour count and the largest pm2_5 and pm10 value for each date.
t4_daily_particulate_summary.instructions: Use the first 10 characters of each time value as the date. Set hours to the number of hourly records for that date. Set pm2_5_max and pm10_max to the largest raw value of each pollutant that day. Do not round or convert values.

t5_trailing_three_hour_peak.name: T5: Trailing three-hour pm2_5 peak
t5_trailing_three_hour_peak.prompt: Create an executable windowed-aggregation workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied Open-Meteo particulate response, compute for each hour the maximum pm2_5 over that hour and the two preceding hours, and post the results to the supplied HTTP sink.
t5_trailing_three_hour_peak.description: For each hour that has two preceding hours, emit the trailing three-hour maximum of pm2_5 alongside the hour's own value.
t5_trailing_three_hour_peak.instructions: Emit one record per hour starting with the third record in the series. Set pm2_5_peak_3h to the maximum pm2_5 among that hour and the two previous hours. Do not emit the first two hours. Do not round values.

t6_earthquake_band_summary.name: T6: Earthquake magnitude-band summary
t6_earthquake_band_summary.prompt: Create an executable aggregation workflow for {platform}. Retrieve the supplied USGS earthquake GeoJSON, classify each event into the magnitude bands used by the USGS ETL task, and post one summary record per band with the event count, largest magnitude, and deepest depth to the supplied HTTP sink.
t6_earthquake_band_summary.description: Group earthquake events by magnitude_band and emit the event count, largest magnitude, and largest depth_km for each band that occurs.
t6_earthquake_band_summary.instructions: Classify each event with the magnitude_band thresholds from the USGS ETL task (minor below 4.0, moderate from 4.0 up to 5.0, major at 5.0 and above). Set max_depth_km from the third element of geometry coordinates. Emit one record per band that has at least one event. Do not round values.
